lines.text: Many learners say: If it will rain tomorrow, I will stay home.
Better: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
After if, use rains, not will rain.
Is! If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.

data.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, I will stay home.
data.right: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
data.why: After if, use rains, not will rain.
data.memory: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.

native.tip: if のあとは未来のことでも現在形。will は使いません。
native.caption: “If it will rain tomorrow, I will stay home.”と言っていませんか？😅 「明日雨が降るなら」という未来の気持ちにつられて will を入れがちです。“If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“is”。“If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: After if, the present tense is used even when talking about the future. Will is not used.
en.caption: Do you say this? “If it will rain tomorrow, I will stay home.” 😅 Do not use will right after if. The natural way is “If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
